lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns. The columns posterior to the gill slits exhibit the largest and most defined centroids, spaced at semi-regular vertical intervals mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear features run horizontally across the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity pixels on the upper edge to low-intensity shadow pixels on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a scattered distribution of approximately 12-15 small white spots, primarily localized within the central and posterior regions of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped indentation or tissue void is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, approximately mid-way between the fin base and distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct elongated dark silhouettes (remora-like forms) are visible immediately ventral to the left pectoral fin.
